memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Insomnia: Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings, daytime fatigue. Insomnia Severity Index score pending. Plan: Start melatonin 3 mg at bedtime and trazodone 50 mg at bedtime. Counsel sleep hygiene.
- Weight: 58 kg, waist 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm). Within normal.
Due: HbA1c in 3 months (though not on glucose‑lowering meds, routine). Next visit in 3 months.

memories.text:
- Insomnia: Patient reports improved sleep onset, still 2‑3 awakenings per night. ISI score 12 (moderate). Plan: Continue current regimen, consider slight trazodone increase if awakenings persist.
- Weight: 59 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut‑off). Advise modest calorie reduction, avoid late‑night snacks.
Due: HbA1c in 3 months. Next visit in 3 months.

memories.text: Insomnia Severity Index score: 12 (moderate). Sleep latency ~30 min, awakenings 2‑3 times, early morning awakening once.

Due: HbA1c in 3 months. Next visit in 3 months.
